title: Imran Khan may be moved to Islamabad's new jail
lines: Imran Khan may soon be moved from Adiala Jail, where he has been held for more than two years.
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi visited Islamabad's new Model Jail on Tuesday, and hinted that the PTI founder could be shifted there.
Asked directly, he said: whosoever is a prisoner of Islamabad will be shifted here.
The jail is in Sector H-sixteen of Islamabad. It covers ninety acres, and is designed for two thousand prisoners.
Work on it began in two thousand and nine. Naqvi said the project had been pending for seventeen years.
Islamabad has never had a working prison of its own, so its prisoners are held at Adiala, in Rawalpindi.
In the first phase, about fifteen hundred prisoners are to be moved. The jail has three barracks, a thirty-five bed hospital, a mosque and a kitchen.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is expected to open the jail in the coming days.
According to jail sources quoted by the Express Tribune, Imran Khan could be moved between November the twentieth and the thirtieth, and a special ward for him is almost ready.
Imran Khan has been in jail since August twenty twenty-three. He is serving a sentence in the one hundred and ninety million pound case, which he and his party call politically motivated.
He also faces trials over the protests of May the ninth, twenty twenty-three. The reports did not include a response from PTI.
